_Jwt: SigningKeyPem is deliberately absent — it is a secret and startup fails without it. Supply it for local runs with `dotnet user-secrets set Jwt:SigningKeyPem "$(openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048)"` or the Jwt__SigningKeyPem env var. Issuer/Audience are not secrets, but startup fails without them too, so dev values live here.
